property_summary: C.transfer reverts when the recipient list is empty and otherwise always returns true, regardless of token address, values, or recipient addresses.
C.transfer returns true even when the underlying token transferFrom call fails, for any addresses and value.
Calling C.transfer never moves Ether into or out of the contract C itself, regardless of parameters.
For any non-empty list of recipients, C.transfer never reverts and returns true, regardless of the token contract, sender, value, or recipients.
C.transfer always returns true even when the underlying token call at caddress is not a token (its call fails), as long as the recipient list is non-empty.
C.transfer always reverts when the recipient list is empty, regardless of sender, token address, or value.
For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer always returns true and never reverts, regardless of whether the underlying transferFrom calls succeed or the token address is arbitrary.
C.transfer must revert whenever the recipient list is empty, for any from/token/value.
For any non-empty recipient list, calling C.transfer never changes the contract's Ether balance (it returns true and leaves address(c).balance unchanged).
For a non-empty recipient list, C.transfer dispatches exactly _tos.length transferFrom calls to the given token address and returns true.
